offense_analyst.prose: Tampa Bay is a heavy run-first team on early downs. It passes on 47.1% of early-down plays [oc1] across 467 snaps [oc2], and only 40.8% on first down [oc3] over 265 plays [oc4]. It has been well under expectation, with a pass rate over expected of -11.9 on early downs [oc5] and -9.8 across all downs [oc6] over 619 plays [oc7]. Its pass offense has been inefficient, at -0.13 EPA per pass play [oc8] over 335 plays [oc9]. On third-and-long it goes to the air on 89.8% of snaps [oc10], but that sample is only 59 plays [oc11], so treat it as small. Egbuka leads the targets at 22.5% [oc12] of 262 team targets [oc13], with Godwin and Otton each at 15.6% [oc14][oc15]. Their average target depth is 7.4 yards [oc16], 11th highest in the league [oc17], so the offense is built on short, quick throws. Play action appears on 20.0% of dropbacks [oc18], and motion on 69.1% of plays [oc19]. Screens are 9.6% of dropbacks [oc20] and RPOs are 7.4% of plays [oc21]. Carolina's defense has sacked the QB on 4.4% of dropbacks [oc22] and has a pressure proxy of 11.6% [oc23]. Carolina has allowed 0.05 EPA per pass play [oc24] over 388 plays [oc25]. On designed runs, Tampa Bay goes left 41.8% of the time [oc26], right 38.9% [oc27], and middle 19.3% [oc28] over 280 runs [oc29]. Plan for their bread-and-butter run game to the perimeter and for the short passing game with play-action off it.

sections.body: Antoine Winfield Jr. (S) is Out with an ankle injury [ic1] after playing 88.8% of snaps per game [ic2] over 6 games [ic3], so expect backups at deep safety and more two-high help for Carolina's shot plays. Josh Hayes (CB) is Out with a knee [ic4], while Baker Mayfield (QB) [ic5] and Yaya Diaby (LB) [ic6] are Questionable. Carolina's Bobby Okereke (LB) is Out with a foot [ic7] after playing 89.0% of snaps per game [ic8] over 7 games [ic9], and Isaiah Simmons (S) is also Out [ic10]. sections.heading: Key matchups
sections.body: The game turns on four matchups. First, the perimeter run game: Tampa Bay runs left on 41.8% of designed runs [mc1] and right on 38.9% [mc2] over 280 designed runs [mc3], and Okereke is out [mc4] after playing 89.0% of snaps per game [mc5], so Carolina's replacement must set the edge on both sides. Second, play action and the short game: Tampa Bay uses play action on 20.0% of dropbacks [mc6], and Egbuka leads targets at 22.5% [mc7] of 262 team targets [mc8], so linebackers must not bite on play fakes. Third, the blitz: Tampa Bay sends extra rushers on 43.1% of dropbacks [mc11] over 364 plays [mc12], and Carolina has allowed a sack on 7.7% of dropbacks [mc13] over 413 plays [mc14], so keep max protection and quick throws. Fourth, safety depth: Antoine Winfield Jr. is out [mc15] after playing 88.8% of snaps per game [mc16] across 6 games [mc17], so take deep shots only against the backups and off play action.
